primary_provider: Hong Kong Lands Department / CSDI Building
height_definition: Raw TopHeight minus BaseHeight of the matched structural component
source_observation_dates: DateCreate/DateStamp retained as record dates, not survey or construction dates
primary_height_policy: structural component TopHeight minus BaseHeight; ground-to-top retained separately
integration_match_policy: Exact unique BuildingCSUID, compatible type, valid source geometry and footprint IoU >=0.95; local footprints retained
verification: Bulk record count equals the official catalog; raw response SHA256 frozen; unique component IDs and WGS84 geometry range checked. Source reports are not independent measurements.
